items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: I had Tom Kubis do a really nice arrangement of it

ctx.x: I just did a — I’ll share a little something with you when we — after we hang up. I did a tribute recording to him that I just mixed and mastered. I did “The Bob Newhart Theme.” And I had Tom Kubis do a really nice arrangement of it, and I’ve got strings on it and everything. And I’ll send it to you. It’s going to get released on January 1 as a matter of fact, just as a little single. And I did it for Pat’s wife, so I’m going to send it to her.
Okay. I got to play that theme, he came to Utica, New York.
